findings.description: The SAFE_PATH_RE regex allows forward slashes at the beginning and end of paths, which could enable directory traversal attacks if used to construct filesystem paths. Consider anchoring more strictly or using a dedicated path validation library.
findings.suggestion: Use /^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$/ to disallow slashes entirely, or validate paths separately if traversal is needed.

findings.description: The guardStep1 through guardStep19 functions are identical implementations. This duplication increases maintenance burden and code size.
findings.suggestion: Extract the common logic into a single helper function and call it with different step identifiers if needed.

findings.description: Import path uses .ts extension which may cause issues depending on the runtime configuration. Deno requires it but Node.js does not.
findings.suggestion: Ensure consistent import behavior across target runtimes or use a build step to handle extensions.

findings.description: The logSafePath function is referenced but not defined in this file. Ensure it properly sanitizes control characters to prevent log injection.
findings.suggestion: Verify the implementation of logSafePath in the referenced internal module.

findings.description: The cliStep1 through cliStep19 functions are identical implementations, duplicating the same pattern as in a-guard.ts.
findings.suggestion: Refactor to use a shared helper function to reduce duplication.

findings.description: Test expects processReview(null) to throw but doesn't specify what error. Tests should be explicit about expected error types/messages.
findings.suggestion: Use expect(() => processReview(null)).toThrow(ExpectedErrorType) or check error message.

findings.description: The processorTestStep1 through processorTestStep18 functions are identical boilerplate, adding unnecessary noise to the test file.
findings.suggestion: Move shared test utilities to a separate test helpers file.

findings.description: The entire file consists of 37 identical functions (filler1Step1 through filler1Step37). This pattern is repeated across multiple filler files.
findings.suggestion: Consider if these files are necessary or if they can be generated/removed to reduce repository bloat.
